caption: The drawing depicts a tall, freestanding grandfather clock with a predominantly brown wooden case featuring lighter and darker wood grain patterns and inlaid decorative designs in oval and circular shapes. The clock stands on four small feet and consists of three main segments: a broad base with a large circular inlay, a central elongated section with an oval inlay and rectangular panels, and an upper section housing the clock face. The clock face is round and white with black Arabic numerals and black clock hands. Above the clock face, within an arched section, is a decorative painted scene with a large half-sun, clouds, and a blue sky. The top of the clock features a double-scroll pediment, a central finial, and smaller finials at both corners. The overall design employs rich reddish-brown and gold tones, with some areas highlighted to emphasize the wood texture and decorative elements. The object is presented with a shaded background to the left, suggesting light coming from the right side of the composition.
title: Clock
